paper.title: Neural Scaling Laws Surpass Chemical Accuracy for the Many-Electron Schrödinger Equation
paper.authors: Du Jiang, Xuelan Wen, Yixiao Chen, Ruichen Li, Weizhong Fu, Hung Q. Pham, Ji Chen, Di He, William A. Goddard III, Liwei Wang, Weiluo Ren

results.system_description: Cyclobutadiene, rectangular (D2h) minimum of Bhaskaran-Nair et al. (2008), all electrons, singlet (14 up, 14 down)
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained network from the inference phase (3e4 evaluation iterations, Supplementary Table 1).
results.notes: Network (4, 256, 4, 32): 4 layers, 256 hidden dimensions, 4 attention heads, 32 determinants. Geometry not printed; the paper compares its barrier with the PauliNet and FermiNet values (Supplementary Table 8), which were computed at the Bhaskaran-Nair et al. (2008) geometries, and the LapNet code used here ships the same coordinates as the FermiNet repository, which is an inference. Printed with thin spaces, e.g. '−154.686 06(3)'. The larger networks of Supplementary Table 7 have no error bars and 'LAVA-SE' is a scaling-law extrapolation; neither is recorded.

results.system_description: Ne atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 5 up and 5 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: Lowest variational energy of the trained network, from the inference phase; the paper calls these 'LAVA's lowest variational energies'.
results.notes: Network (4, 512, 8, 128): 4 layers, 512 hidden dimensions, 8 attention heads, 128 determinants (Supplementary Sec. on period-3 atoms). N_up = 5, N_down = 5: not printed, but the 1S ground term of Ne lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). Printed with a thin space, '−128.937 943(7)'. The 'Expt. Derived' column is the Chakravorty et al. estimate.

results.system_description: Si atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 8 up and 6 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: Lowest variational energy of the trained network, from the inference phase; the paper calls these 'LAVA's lowest variational energies'.
results.notes: Network (4, 512, 8, 128): 4 layers, 512 hidden dimensions, 8 attention heads, 128 determinants (Supplementary Sec. on period-3 atoms). N_up = 8, N_down = 6 (M_S = S of the 3P ground term of Si): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that the FermiNet-family code assigns (Hund's rule). A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance. Printed with a thin space, '−289.359 43(2)'. The 'Expt. Derived' column is the Chakravorty et al. estimate.
